# Live-contract fixtures (anonymized)

Captured 2026-09-24 from hh.ru with the account owner's authorized session
(response bodies only — no request headers, no cookies, no tokens). Source
files: `/tmp/opencode/live/{chats-list,resumes,popup,counts,rating}.json`.

| File | Endpoint | Shape notes (live-verified) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `counts.json` | `GET /shards/vacancy/counts` | `{"counts":1630}` — plain int |
| `resumes.json` | `GET /shards/applicant/resumes` | all resume fields inside `_attributes` (hash/hhid/id/isSearchable/percent/status/publishState/nextTouchAt/updated(ms-epoch)/canTouch/...); `professionalRole` is `[{"string":N}]` |
| `popup.json` | `GET /applicant/vacancy_response/popup?vacancyId=N` | JSON envelope; structured data in `responseStatus` (test/shortVacancy/resumeInconsistencies-dict/negotiations.topicList/alreadyApplied/responseImpossible) and `responsePopup`; letterRequired = `responseStatus.shortVacancy["@responseLetterRequired"]` |
| `rating.json` | `GET /employer_reviews/proxy_components/small_widget?employerId=N` | proxied-component envelope; `employerReviews.totalRating` is a STRING; `last3MonthsReviewsInfo` has NO totalRating (only counts); review entries carry `totalRating` (string) + `creationTime` (RFC3339) |
| `chats-list.json` | `GET chatik/api/chats?page=N` | `chats.items[].id` is an INT; per-chat `resources.{VACANCY,RESUME,NEGOTIATION_TOPIC}` are string-id lists; `lastMessage.workflowTransition{topicId,applicantState}`; top-level `resources.negotiation_topics{topicId:{...,currentApplicantState}}` (DISCARD = structural refusal) and `resources.vacancies{vacId:{@responseLetterRequired,chatWritePossibility,autoResponse,...}}`; `chatsDisplayInfo[chatId]{title,subtitle,icon}` |

## Scrub policy

- Removed/replaced: personal and manager names, company names/visible names,
  department codes, phones, emails, photo/logo/avatar URLs, salaries,
  cover-letter and chat-message texts, review pros/cons, sentry/trace ids,
  inline scripts.
- Deterministic id remap: every application-linked id (users, resumes, hashes
  re-hashed, vacancies, employers, topics, chats, messages, managers) is
  replaced by a stable fake (numeric ids `>= 10000` → `10000001+`, same source
  id maps to the same fake everywhere, dict keys included). Types and id
  cross-references are preserved.
- Preserved: JSON structure, key names (incl. `@`-prefixed), enum values
  (`DISCARD`, `RESPONSE_BY_APPLICANT`, `ENABLED_AFTER_INVITATION`, ...), date
  formats, string-vs-number typing.
- Known benign leftovers: hh.ru product domains (`dreamjob.ru` in the
  localization/domain dictionaries) and public city names; timestamps kept for
  window heuristics. No credentials ever appear in these bodies.
- Derivation: generated by a deterministic scrubber (throwaway, `opencode`
  tmp) from the live captures; regenerate by re-running the scrubber, never
  by editing by hand.
